2026 Interactive

Disc Golf Flight Guide

How To
Use the Marshall Street Disc Golf Flight Guide to compare disc flight numbers, speed, stability, and estimated flight paths across leading brands. Faster drivers appear near the top, while slower midranges and putters appear lower. Overstable discs are on the left and understable discs are on the right.

New players should start with speed 7 or lower and explore the understable side. Discs in the same chart cell have similar flights. Search by mold, filter by manufacturer, or select discs to compare. Click any disc to view its flight path, specifications, reviews, and photographed discs available to buy.
Features
  • Search and brands: Search for a mold, or choose manufacturers to narrow the chart. Brand colors also serve as the chart's color key.
  • Quick Start: Open Filters and choose your throwing distance for a starting point. Adjust disc type, maximum speed, and stability to refine your choices.
  • Availability: Use Available now or On sale in Filters to narrow your results. Clear all filters to start again.
  • Compare flights: Choose Compare, select up to six molds, then compare their estimated flights. Adjust arm speed, throwing hand, and backhand or forehand to explore different throws.
  • Explore and shop: Open a disc for flight numbers, its estimated flight path, and product information. Browse photographed inventory, check weight and color, and add your exact disc to the cart.
  • Popular molds: Use Find on chart to locate a mold or Shop now to browse its available discs.
  • Saved discs: Save molds from comparison, then choose Show saved discs in Filters to find them again.

Flight illustrations are estimates. Plastic, weight, wear, wind, and release affect real flights.

Stability

Saved discs are molds you save from comparison. Choose “Show saved discs,” then use “Remove saved disc” on any result to manage them quickly.

Compare mode is on. Choose up to 6 discs from the chart below.
